facts.label: Comparar bebidas
facts.sub: Use -er than para comparar e would like para oferecer e pedir: The lemonade is colder than the juice. I’d like the big juice.

facts.label: Comparar
facts.sub: Use adjetivo + er + than para comparar bebidas: The lemonade is sweeter than the juice. Cold vira colder. Hot dobra o t: hotter. Cheap vira cheaper.

facts.label: Oferecer
facts.sub: Would you like a cold drink? é uma oferta educada. Responda Yes, please ou No, thank you. Para pedir, diga I’d like the big juice.

pages.title: A small cafe · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Saturday afternoon in a small cafe in Calgary. The sun is strong and the street is hot. Kim fills a cup with ice. Her friend Max comes in with a red face. He wants something cold. Kim shows him the drinks.
“Hi, Max! It’s hot today. Would you like a cold drink?” says Kim. “Yes, please. What’s the best cold drink here?” says Max. “The lemonade is sweeter than the juice.” says Kim.
